package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Fill hands back a *Queries through an output parameter instead of a result, so a guard that
// only inspects a function's Results and never its Params misses it entirely.
func Fill(dst **Queries, pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	*dst = &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
}
